as_told.title: String theory as a blocking mechanism against dangerous physics

plain: String theory, a branch of physics that tries to explain everything as tiny vibrating strings, may have been pushed on purpose as a dead end, to keep physicists away from dangerous work. Michels puts the question himself, asking whether the theory, which the physicist Ed Witten worked on, is "intentionally a bridge to nowhere." A mathematician named Eric Weinstein makes it his own claim, calling it a possible "blocking mechanism" and tying it to an account he attributes to Andreessen and Horowitz about classified physics, and naming Witten and the physicist Brian Greene.
